summary: Roku, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 14, 2026, announcing a definitive merger agreement with Fox Corporation. Under the terms, each share of Roku common stock will be exchanged for 0.9693 Fox Class A shares plus $96.00 in cash, implying a mixed cash-stock consideration. The transaction is structured as a two-step merger starting with a forward subsidiary merger followed by a second-step merger, with Roku becoming a wholly owned subsidiary of Fox. Roku's board unanimously approved and recommends stockholder adoption. The deal is subject to regulatory approvals and stockholder vote, with appraisal rights available. Watch for regulatory clearance timeline and potential competing bids.
